policy.note: Editorial candidates only. Promotion is explicit and gated; application code consumes canonical runtime assets only.

assets.name: Queen angelfish
assets.qaNote: Strong silhouette and palette; markings slightly stylized but recognizable.

assets.name: Hawksbill sea turtle
assets.qaNote: Excellent hooked beak, shell character and proportions.

assets.name: Spotted eagle ray
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: eagle-ray disc/head silhouette and dense white dorsal spotting read clearly at card scale; long whip tail is explicit. Composite source uses an AI-generated specimen isolated into the established sunlit Caribbean scene treatment.

assets.name: Nurse shark
assets.qaNote: Resolved: paired barbels, broad flattened head and rear-set dorsal fins make the candidate reliably recognizable at card scale.

assets.name: Green moray
assets.qaNote: Strong recognizable form, colour and head shape.

assets.name: Great barracuda
assets.qaNote: Very recognizable; teeth slightly exaggerated.

assets.name: Stoplight parrotfish
assets.qaNote: Resolved: robust parrotfish body and beak plus terminal-phase green/red pattern are sufficiently diagnostic despite restrained stylization.

assets.name: Caribbean reef squid
assets.qaNote: Resolved: elongate mantle, full-length lateral fins and reef-squid posture are recognizable; multi-animal composition is acceptable editorially.

assets.name: Caribbean spiny lobster
assets.qaNote: Excellent antennae, armored body and coloration.

assets.name: Caribbean reef octopus
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: eight long arms, loose webbing, paired sucker rows visible on foreground arms, dark reddish-brown eyes and a green/blue skin state with red-brown mottling; avoids a generic studio red/brown octopus presentation.

assets.name: French angelfish
assets.qaNote: Strong species-specific coloration and silhouette.

assets.name: Spotted trunkfish
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: adult reads pale/whitish with dense dark spots and no pre-eye horns; the prior inverted dark-body/white-spot failure is removed. AI-generated specimen was pattern-corrected and isolated into the established sunlit Caribbean scene treatment.

assets.name: Queen triggerfish
assets.qaNote: Strong tail, body and facial coloration; content authority now maps this approved source to queen-triggerfish.

assets.name: Nassau grouper
assets.qaNote: Broad bars, grouper form and head pattern work well.

assets.name: Blue tang
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: Atlantic Acanthurus coeruleus presentation with a deep compressed blue surgeonfish body, fine flank lines and blue tail; the Indo-Pacific Paracanthurus black/yellow palette is explicitly removed. AI-generated specimen was identity-corrected and isolated into the established scene treatment.

assets.name: Southern stingray
assets.qaNote: Convincing silhouette and dorsal view.

assets.name: Trumpetfish
assets.qaNote: Resolved: extremely elongate body, tubular snout and small posterior fins make Aulostomus maculatus recognizable at gallery scale.

assets.name: Longsnout seahorse
assets.qaNote: Resolved: long snout and slender seahorse profile are usable; colour is variable in life, so identity confidence remains medium rather than overstated.

assets.name: Yellowtail snapper
assets.qaNote: Excellent profile, stripe/tail and silver-blue body.

assets.name: Porcupinefish
assets.qaNote: Strong Diodon-type asset; canonical label must match.

assets.name: Longspine sea urchin
assets.qaNote: Excellent and highly recognizable; content authority now maps this approved source to longspine-sea-urchin.

assets.name: Banded coral shrimp
assets.qaNote: Strong red/white banding, antennae and claw profile; content authority now maps this approved source to banded-coral-shrimp.

assets.name: Schoolmaster snapper
assets.qaNote: Good yellow fins/stripes and snapper silhouette.

assets.name: Spanish hogfish
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: adult Bodianus rufus identification is carried by the robust hogfish form plus the explicit lilac/blue-grey upper and yellow lower-body division; generic red-wrasse coloration is removed. Identity remains medium because the corrected source is intentionally stylized.

assets.name: Caribbean cushion sea star
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: reference-guided opaque scene restores the thick inflated five-armed cushion form, broad central disc, robust tapering arms and coarse knobbed/reticulated dorsal texture; the flat generic-star geometry failure is removed.

assets.name: Sergeant major
assets.qaNote: Strong five-bar appearance and Caribbean reef-fish form.

assets.name: Porkfish
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: deep compressed grunt body with yellow overall impression, exactly two dark head bars (through the eye and immediately behind the operculum) and blue/yellow longitudinal striping; generic broad-bar grunt treatment is removed.

assets.name: Queen conch
assets.qaNote: Replacement v2: adult heavy weathered shell with broad flared pink/orange lip plus visible living eyestalks and proboscis; the shell-only souvenir presentation failure is removed.

assets.name: Juvenile spotted drum
assets.qaNote: Strong juvenile black/white profile with trailing fins; content authority maps the juvenile presentation to the species-level spotted-drum record (Eques punctatus).

assets.name: Green sea turtle
assets.qaNote: Good rounded head and smoother shell distinguish it from hawksbill.

assets.name: Banded butterflyfish
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: disc-like silver butterflyfish with four broad black vertical bars and no rear ocellus; the foureye-butterflyfish false-eye pattern is explicitly absent and the silhouette remains legible at card scale.

assets.name: Bar jack
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: silver/light-blue streamlined jack with a strongly forked tail; blue upper-body stripe and adjacent black stripe remain visible into the tail treatment at card scale.

assets.name: Blue chromis
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: dark electric-blue elongate oval with a deeply forked pointed tail and explicit dark upper/lower tail and fin margins; reads distinctly from deeper-bodied damselfish.

assets.name: Bluestriped grunt
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: yellow grunt body with strong blue longitudinal striping plus dark caudal and soft-dorsal treatment; the cues remain clear at collection-card scale.

assets.name: Hogfish
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: pale terminal-male presentation with deep oblong body, long pointed snout, first three dorsal spines extended as filaments, and dark forehead/nape and tail-base markings.

assets.name: Queen parrotfish
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: terminal-phase queen parrotfish with blue mouth/muzzle treatment, oblique blue eye-to-mid-back stripe and a clearly pink-edged tail; kept visually distinct from princess parrotfish.

assets.name: Sharpnose puffer
assets.qaNote: Issue #33 reviewed keep: long pointed snout, brown upper/yellowish lower body, thin blue eye/snout lines and blue body spots, plus a yellow tail with broad dark upper/lower margins and pale central base.
